title: astragalus commodus
intro: Astragalus commodus, commonly known as Huangqi or Milky Vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to China and Mongolia. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus commodus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, polysaccharides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
